title: Iterator Concierge: cross-SDK pagination & batching pattern for embeddings + rerank
creator: Priya Nair
description:
Problem: Python/TS/Go SDKs have grown slightly divergent in how they expose pagination, batching, and streaming for embeddings + reranking flows. Engineers building vector search and reranking pipelines see friction: inconsistent cursor shapes, different retry semantics when partial batches fail, and no single pattern that composes cleanly with streaming token output or long-running prefetch.

Goal: Ship a cross-language "Iterator Concierge" pattern and helper primitives that give idiomatic SDK UX (iterator/async iterator/cursor), clear retry and backpressure semantics, and an examples gallery demonstrating common compositions (synchronous bulk embed -> streaming rerank, streaming embed -> batched rerank, resumable cursor + incremental caching). This ticket captures design, API proposals, reference implementations, tests, and docs for the first pass.
acceptance_criteria: Canonical iterator API defined for Python, TS, Go with parity in behaviours and naming conventions
Retry profile documented and implemented: per-batch idempotent retry with configurable backoff and max-attempts; partial-batch failure surfaced with clear error shape
Cursor token standard: small opaque token that encodes offset and batch metadata and can be resumed across SDKs
Batching helpers provided: BatchSize(n), MaxDelay(ms) combinators that work with streaming sources
Examples in repo: python/ts/go snippets for three common pipelines and one end-to-end integration test against the hosted embeddings+rerank playground
Benchmarks comparing default vs Iterator Concierge for 1k, 10k document workloads (latency, tokens/sec, CPU/GPU utilization)
Docs and migration notes added to /docs/sdk/pagination and example playground in console templates

decisions: Use a single opaque resume token (base64 JSON) rather than language-specific offsets so clients can hand tokens between SDKs
Retry semantics: idempotent per-batch retries only; do not auto-retry whole cursor on streaming generator error to avoid duplication unless user enables exactly-once semantics
Expose two ergonomics: high-level convenience function `concierge_iter` and low-level primitives `Batcher`, `Prefetcher`, `RetryProfile`
Keep default BatchSize conservative (32) and MaxDelay 50ms; provide easy config for bursty workloads
No changes to server-side API — all compatibility maintained; SDKs will map server pagination params to iterator behavior
